business_problem: Rakuten wanted to augment both business clients and employees with AI products for market analysis, support, and knowledge work while keeping control over prompt quality, model experimentation, and enterprise data separation across a sprawling multi-business environment.
solution_summary: Rakuten built a portfolio of AI products on LangChain and LangSmith rather than a single assistant. Rakuten AI for Business serves clients with AI Analyst for market intelligence and chart-backed research, AI Agent for self-serve marketplace support, and AI Librarian for real-time answers over merchant documentation. Internally, the team used LangChain’s OpenGPTs package to stand up an employee platform where teams can build chatbots over internal knowledge. LangChain supplied the reusable chains, agents, and interoperability Rakuten needed to iterate quickly without locking into one model vendor. As usage scaled, LangSmith Hub became the mechanism for distributing the best prompts across teams, while LangSmith Testing and Eval ran custom metrics across models and cognitive architectures inside Rakuten’s own environment with separate development and production access controls.
